title: Fraktalmotorn scene, version 49
description: A scene: camera, camera paths and what to draw. Data only, never code. The $id is a placeholder until a permanent home for the schema is chosen.

source.const: NOEMA bounded geometric AST synthesis; textbook geometry

content.description: What is drawn. Entries of unknown types are ignored with a warning by the engine.

chain.description: Formula steps, run one after the other.

formula.description: The id of a formula file.

iterations.description: Left out: the formula's own default.

step_factor.description: Safety margin for this formula (version 10): march steps are multiplied by the smallest factor in the chain. Left out: 1.

every.description: Alternate mode (version 11): run on every n-th round. Left out: 1.

start.description: Alternate mode (version 11): the first round (from 0) the step runs on. Left out: 0.

weight.description: Interpolate mode (version 11): the weight of this step in the blend. Left out: 1.

rounds.description: How many times the whole chain is repeated.

mode.description: How the steps are combined (version 11). Left out: sequence.

coloring.description: Opt-in winning dIFS shape OTrap; omitted retains legacy distance coloring.

julia.description: Julia mode (version 11): the constant c is added in every iteration instead of the point itself.

credits.description: Filled in when a scene is saved. Authors and sources of the formulas used, with their verification status.

lights.description: Light sources (added in version 9). Left out: the one directional light the shader used to have built in.

intensity.description: Directional: brightness. Point and spot: brightness at distance 1 (it weakens with the square of the distance).

direction.description: The direction the light shines in (directional and spot). Not all 0.

position.description: Where the light is (point and spot).

cone_degrees.description: Spot: half angle of the cone.

ambient.description: The ambient light (added in version 9). Left out: white at 0.12, as before.

materialProperty.description: A number from 0 to 1, or a property driven by a measure of the surface through a curve.

measure.description: color means the same measure as the colour uses.

curve.description: Points with rising positions; the value is interpolated between them and held beyond the ends.

material.description: The material of the surface (added in version 13): glTF metallic-roughness. Left out: matt, no metal, no reflection, exactly as before.

environment.description: What is seen behind the shape and what lights it from all sides (added in version 12). Left out: the gradient sky.

data.description: A Radiance .hdr picture (an equirectangular map, twice as wide as high, at most 1024 x 512), as a data address.

author.description: Who made the picture, as far as the user knows.

source.description: Where the picture comes from: a link or a reference (LICENSING.md section 9).

license.description: The licence of the picture, for example CC0 1.0.

intensity.description: A factor on the light of the picture (exposure). Left out: 1.

background_visible.description: Whether the picture is seen behind the shape. Left out: true.

fog.description: Fog (added in version 8): colour mixed in with distance, 1 - exp(-density * (distance - start)), or the squared form. Left out: switched off.

affects_sky.description: Whether the sky (rays that hit nothing) becomes the fog colour.

render.description: Image format and size. Optional exact manual resolution (version 18). GPU jobs are tiled independently of output dimensions.

ratio.description: Width and height proportions, only used with preset custom (at most 10 to 1).

fov_axis.description: Which direction camera.fov_degrees is measured in.

quality.description: Detail controls for final pictures (added in version 7). Left out: the values that were built into the shader before (1 sample, hit_precision 0.0004, step_factor 0.75, max_steps 220, max_distance 60, normal_epsilon 0.0008).

camera_sampling.description: Opt-in progressive per-pixel scrambled camera coverage. Absent preserves the original R2 sequence.

normal_policy.description: Opt-in primary surface shading detail relative to the target film. Absent preserves legacy behavior.

hit_policy.description: Opt-in half target-film pixel primary acceptance cap. Normals, DE semantics and march budgets remain separate. Absent preserves legacy behavior.

precision_floor.description: Opt-in scale of the Float32 floor of hit threshold and normal step. Absent or 1 = the floor of earlier scenes.

precision_mode.description: fixed: hit_precision and normal_epsilon; pixel: hit_pixels and normal_pixels, a share of one pixel (version 10).

color.description: How the surface is coloured. The gradient is stored inside the scene, so the file is self-contained.

transition.description: Material Gradient: width of the blend towards the next stop, 0 (hard) to 1 (whole interval, the old linear blend).

softness.description: Material Gradient 2: how soft the edges of the transition band are, 0 (crisp linear ramp) to 1 (smooth step). Absent = the old behaviour.

material.description: Material Gradient: a self-contained snapshot of the blendable part of a material. active=false keeps it for reversibility. At most 16 stops per gradient.

textures.description: Material Gradient 2: the PBR maps of the material (baseColor, roughness, metallic, ao only; at most 4 distinct textured materials per gradient).

textureScale.description: Material Gradient 2: repetitions per object unit for all maps of this material.

texture.description: A picture laid over the surface colour. The picture is stored inside the scene as a data address.

animation.description: Keyframes along a timeline. The chain of formulas stays the same for the whole animation; each keyframe holds the camera, the parameter values of each chain step (same order) and the colouring.

speed_mode.description: How the camera moves between keyframes. Both keep the keyframe times.

keyframes.description: In time order, each later than the one before.

julia_c.description: The Julia constant at this keyframe (version 11).
